articles.title: Myanmar’s New Administration: Military Consolidation, Not Transition
articles.summary: Myanmar's Min Aung Hlaing transitioned from commander-in-chief to president after Five years after mounting a coup that ousted an elected civilian government, Min Aung Hlaing has overseen tightly staged elections transitioning him from commander-in-chief to president. articles.title: As Cease-Fire Brings Uneasy Calm, Iranians Wonder What Comes Next
articles.summary: A cease-fire has brought calm to Iran.
